name: Sunday Service
description: Our main weekly service — vibrant worship with joy unspeakable, the Word in demonstration, and glorious fellowship. Come early for prevailing intercession and function in dominion.

name: Prayer & Prophecy Service
description: Mondays we pray, prophesy and prevail — an hour of fervent intercession, prophetic utterance and impartation to chart your week in ever-increasing glory. Glory!

name: Midweek Service
description: Refuelled in the Word, refreshed by the Spirit — deep teaching, prevailing prayer and impartation for the triumphant, ever-winning life in Christ.

name: Communion Service
description: Holy Communion — in remembrance of the Lord, we proclaim divine health, superabundant prosperity and covenant blessings in Christ. Hallelujah!

name: Children's Church
description: Champions for Christ — raising children established in the Word and the love of the Spirit, bold, excellent and ever-joyous.
